verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs state that its observability system gives visibility into every agent run, workflow step, tool call and model interaction (mastra-docs-8). Studio provides a visual environment for inspecting traces and agent runs, both locally at localhost:4111 and hosted (mastra-docs-56, mastra-docs-50). That covers the story's core of tracing LLM and tool calls in a UI. Missing for 10: detailed docs on trace contents, span structure or export integrations; no independent or hands-on corroboration of the tracing UI.
